run_chinese_tokenization: run the script to tokenize Chinese text from stdin or input files using sacrebleu
tokenize_zh_text: tokenize Chinese text line by line using sacrebleu's tokenize_zh function
batch_tokenize_zh_files: batch tokenize multiple Chinese text files by passing them as arguments to the script
pipe_zh_text: pipe Chinese text into the script via stdin to get tokenized output on stdout
review_tokenize_zh_script: review the tokenize_zh script that wraps sacrebleu.tokenize_zh for line-by-line Chinese tokenization
